media.alt_text: DHS Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas Announces Inaugural Members of Tribal Homeland Security Advisory Council

tweets.text: The council will advise @SecMayorkas on homeland security policies and practices that affect Indian Country, including emergency management, law enforcement, cybersecurity, domestic terrorism and targeted violence, and border security. https://t.co/wws39NcbIS
tweets.text_resolved: The council will advise @SecMayorkas on homeland security policies and practices that affect Indian Country, including emergency management, law enforcement, cybersecurity, domestic terrorism and targeted violence, and border security. https://t.co/wws39NcbIS

media.alt_text:
I am deeply proud to appoint the inaugural members of the Tribal Homeland Security Advisory Council, and I applaud their commitment to help build and strengthen the integral partnership between indigenous communities and our Department of Homeland Security.

Importantly, their advice and counsel will better enable our Department to uphold its responsibilities to Tribal Nations, as we work hand-in-hand to address key areas of the homeland security mission relating to Indian Country.
